critic_risk_flags: Explicit H compartment is flagged as weakly identifiable for short single-season series; observing H directly can still leave H/I transition rates underdetermined and invite compensatory dynamics, especially with only 31 training points.

Combines two flexibility sources (SEIRS waning + long delay=3), increasing non-identifiability (waning vs timing) and overfitting risk for a single-season 31-week training series; likely unstable across rolling windows.

I+H observation is poorly aligned with the stated target semantics (hospitalization rate). It adds ambiguity in attribution between prevalence and admissions and can mask timing/shape errors, increasing identifiability risk without clear justification.
